title: Notification Rule Collection
description: Collects branch notification rules. Each document in the collection is one rule: which event triggers it, which channels deliver it, and whether it is active.

label.description: Human-readable name of the notification rule, shown in the admin list.

event.description: Event that triggers the rule: 'enrollment' fires when a learner enrolls, 'completion' when they finish an activity, 'expiry' when a certification nears expiry.

channels.description: Delivery channels for the notification: 'email' sends mail, 'sms' sends a text message.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is currently active.
